mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member(id, name, pass) VALUES(#{id}, #{name}, #{pass})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id id ,m.name name ,m.pass pass ,mf.fileid fileid ,mf.filename filename ,mf.filepath filepath ,mf.originFilename originFilename FROM member m LEFT OUTER JOIN member_file mf ON m.id = mf.member_id WHERE m.id = #{id}
